prompt: Open 9F69. Make Lys142 blue, and draw it as blue ball-and-stick as well.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 1 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.5)
equivalent answer succeeds: label chain and label number
wrong answer fails: no representationColor (the added representation stays element-coloured) (F1 0.5)
wrong answer fails: the author number in residue_number (F1 0.0)
provenance.derived: As api-residue-colour, plus an added representation in the same colour. In pdbe-molstar 3.3.2 `color` paints only the representations the structure already has; the added one takes its colour from `representationColor`.
